1
Koi Manay Ya Na Manay Fatima Hai Fatima.
Jis Ke Laiq Mustafa Hain Woh Atta Hai Fatima.
Do Muhammad Paal Kar Tu Ne Diye Islam Ko.
Baap Ne Youn Tujh Ko Apni Maa Kaha Hai.

2
Khud Ko Woh Hasnain Ka Darzi Kahey Ga Umar Bhar.
Aap Ne Rizwaan Ko Darzi Keh Diya Hai Fatima.
Apni Darhi Se Safai Tere Dar Ki Raat Bhar.
Kaun Hai Jo Youn Tahajud Parh Raha Hai Fatima.

3
Joor Kar Hathoon Ko Apne Hur Ne Yeh Aawaz Di.
Aap Ke Hathoon Mein Mera Faisla Hai Fatima.
Mukhtasir Khair-Al-Nisa Ka Bas Yehi Mafhoom Hai.
Alam-e-Niswaan Ki Khatir Mustafa Hai Fatima.

4
Sehan-e-Kaba Tak Bhi Jane Ki Na Zehmat Di Gayi.
Tujh Ko Har Beta Musallay Par Mila Hai Fatima.
Mehdi-e-Doraan Takallum Hai Jahan Par Aaj Bhi.
Pardah-e-Ghaibat Nahi Teri Rida Hai Fatima.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/fatima-hai-fatima-tajpoints-aeaece68a3334a19be6b.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
normalize = lambda s: [line.strip().removesuffix('.').casefold() for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
assert normalize(roman) == normalize(original)
for version, digits in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = version.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, digit in zip(blocks, digits):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == digit and len(lines) == 5
print('Verified four aligned stanzas, sixteen verses, and preserved Roman wording.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 Urdu verses across four stanzas in [Fatima Hai Fatima](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/855dab1d6c7d41c0b24a583184e1c0f1/src/data/lyrics/fatima-hai-fatima-tajpoints-aeaece68a3334a19be6b.md). Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, standardized its casing and verse endings, and verified that the stanza and verse counts match.

I read “Atta” as عطا and “Alam-e-Niswaan” as عالمِ نسواں. The Urdu title and right-to-left direction are set, and the `noUrdu` tag was removed.
